name: McGill Go
tagline: Finds which courses at exchange universities count toward a McGill student's degree.
problem: Exchange planning is fragmented; course-equivalency information is scattered across systems and PDFs.
solution: Gathers equivalency data from university sources with scraping and AI, and lets students search host-university courses that match their program requirements.
demo_moment: Team-described: pick a host university and see which courses fit your degree.

why_it_stood_out.claim: The team was planning its own exchange.
A narrow, local problem every judge at McGill could recognise won first place.

lessons: A painful, local, concrete problem can beat flashier projects.
